items.title: Alphonse Picou Interview, 1958-04-04
items.q: Did you ever play the Bame System Clarinet or always the Albert? ... I played both of them. ... because Albert for jazz is more easy than the band.

ctx.x: Did you ever play the Bame System Clarinet or always the Albert? Oh, yeah. I played both of them. You played both of them? Yeah. But already Albert. Why do you like the Albert better? Yeah, because Albert for jazz is more easy than the band. Because the band has got too much keys. And the Albert, he got less keys than the band. That's why I'm mad.
Do you think there's any difference in the tone? Albert. Albert. Do you think there's any difference in the tone? No. No difference in the tone? No difference in the tone. No difference in the tone.

Do you use a double arm butcher or do you put your teeth on the, on the black guy? No, don't put your teeth. You put your teeth on the upper. No, no. E top. No, no. You're going to ruin your head. Vibration. Yeah.
